data.narrative:
Fourth Power, a Series A climate and energy company founded by Asegun Henry and Arvin Ganesan, operates within a sector populated by 1 public comparable (LNZA) and 8 private peers including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. The company has raised $40M+ to date.

Valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $40M total raised as a baseline proxy, yielding an $80M implied valuation. Peer-median triangulation is not applicable; while 9 same-sector peers exist in the Climate & Energy universe, insufficient data points satisfy narrow stage and tier filters (fewer than 3 comparable-stage, comparable-tier transactions), making a sector-wide median unreliable without introducing material bias.

The single-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $68M (low) to $92M (high), with a median of $80M. This range reflects typical Series A progression mechanics but carries meaningful uncertainty around comparable transaction multiples, given the small peer set and heterogeneity of business models within frontier energy and materials. Refinement would benefit from additional same-stage private transactions or disclosed valuations among the identified peer group.
